candidates.name: Geospatial User Feedback (GUF)
verified_facts: GUF defines a conceptual data model and XML encoding for feedback produced by consumers of geospatial data products.
Feedback can include ratings, comments, quality reports, citations and significant events about data use.
semantic_limits: User feedback and ratings are metadata about experience and cannot substitute for independently measured terrain values or formal accuracy statistics.

candidates.name: GML in JPEG 2000 (GMLJP2)
verified_facts: GMLJP2 defines how GML is used within JPEG 2000 files for geographic imagery.
The standard provides packaging mechanisms and application schemas for geographic imagery.
semantic_limits: Geospatial imagery packaging and embedded GML do not improve the source image's measurement precision, terrain classification or vertical accuracy.
